info.name: Education Management REST API
info.description:
Complete test suite for the Education Management System API.

## Setup
1. Start the app: `mvn spring-boot:run`
2. Import `Education-API.postman_environment.json` and select it.
3. Press **Run collection** - folders execute in order 00 -> 07.

## Why the order matters
Teachers must exist before courses; courses and students before enrollments; enrollments and exams before grades. Each request saves the id it creates into a collection variable, so later requests reference real rows instead of hard-coded ids.

## Folder 07
Every request in folder 07 is *expected* to fail with a 4xx. Those tests pass when the API rejects bad input correctly.
